# Pre-Tasks Gate Checklist: E-Commerce Platform MVP

**Purpose**: Formal requirements-quality gate over spec.md, plan.md, research.md, data-model.md and contracts/ before `/speckit-tasks`, covering security & privacy, inter-service contracts & events, order/stock/payment domain rules, and platform & non-functional requirements
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Security & Privacy Requirements

- [x] CHK001 Are authorisation requirements stated per operation, with the required role, in every contract and consistent with the deny-by-default rule in FR-005 (for example optional bearer on catalogue reads versus anonymous-only elsewhere)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, contracts/openapi/*]
- [x] CHK002 Is "throttled" in FR-006 quantified identically everywhere (5 failures, per account and per IP, 15 minutes) across spec US3, research §9 and data-model §3.1? [Clarity, Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK003 Are token lifetimes (access 15 min, refresh 30 days, verification 24 h, reset 1 h) stated as requirements rather than only as research decisions, so they can be tested? [Completeness, research §9, data-model §3.1]
- [x] CHK004 Does the spec define what "anonymise" covers (fields replaced, retained pseudonym, address snapshot timing on open orders) in a way that resolves the FR-007 conflict noted in plan.md? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, plan.md Design Decisions]
- [x] CHK005 Are the PII fields that must never appear in logs or traces enumerated, and is the redaction requirement traceable to each service that handles them? [Gap, Spec §FR-025, Constitution III]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements defined for secrets handling in the platform (runner registration token, registry credentials, JWT signing keys, key rotation)? [Gap, research §4–§5, §9]
- [x] CHK007 Is the account-enumeration protection (generic 202 on register and reset) stated in the spec rather than only in identity.yaml? [Completeness, Spec §US3 scenario 2, contracts/openapi/identity.yaml]
- [x] CHK008 Are the self-hosted-runner safeguards in research §4 expressed as mandatory, verifiable requirements with a stated fallback condition, given GitHub's guidance against self-hosted runners on public repositories? [Measurability, research §4, Constitution III]
- [x] CHK009 Does each threat-model row in plan.md map to at least one functional requirement or acceptance scenario, and is every FR with a security impact covered by a row? [Traceability, plan.md Threat Model]
- [x] CHK010 Are requirements for sensitive data inside events (verification and reset tokens in `AccountRegistered`/`PasswordResetRequested`) complete: topic access restriction, non-logging, retention? [Completeness, contracts/asyncapi/events.yaml, plan.md Design Decisions]

## Inter-Service Contract & Event Requirements

- [x] CHK011 Is the error contract (RFC 9457 problem document, status codes used, field-error shape) identical across all six OpenAPI files and referenced by the gateway requirements? [Consistency, contracts/openapi/*, contracts/gateway-routes.md]
- [x] CHK012 Are the correlation-id requirements (accepted header, validation rule, replacement behaviour, echo on every response) stated once and consistently in spec, research §3, gateway-routes.md and every contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-025, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK013 Is every event listed in data-model §4.1 defined in events.yaml with a producer, at least one consumer or an explicit "informational, no consumer" note, and a payload sufficient for each consumer's stated need? [Completeness, data-model §4.1, contracts/asyncapi/events.yaml]
- [x] CHK014 Are the duplicate-tolerance requirements for consumers (dedupe key, processed-event retention of 7 days, ordering guarantees per key) stated as requirements and consistent between research §7, data-model §1 and events.yaml? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK015 Is the schema-evolution rule (additive within v1, breaking change creates v2) defined for both HTTP paths and topics, with what "breaking" means? [Clarity, Spec §VI, research §7]
- [x] CHK016 Does the Pact matrix cover every synchronous dependency implied by the design (gateway→identity JWKS, order→cart, order→catalog reserve/commit/release, order→payment, cart→catalog) and every event consumer, with the verifying side named? [Coverage, contracts/pact-matrix.md, Constitution V]
- [x] CHK017 Are the decline-reason categories defined once and used identically in order.yaml, payment.yaml and events.yaml, with the spec's "decline reason category" wording pointing to that list? [Consistency, Spec §US4 scenario 2, research §11]
- [x] CHK018 Are pagination, sorting and size-limit requirements stated for every list endpoint (orders newest first, products paged, notifications) and consistent with SC-002's 10,000-product catalogue? [Completeness, Spec §US5 scenario 1, contracts/openapi/*]
- [x] CHK019 Is the anonymous cart identity (`X-Cart-Token`) specified in the spec in terms of issuance, lifetime (30 days idle) and merge-consumption behaviour, not only in cart.yaml? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008–009, data-model §3.3]
- [x] CHK020 Are internal-only operations (payment charge/refund creation, catalog reserve/commit/release) distinguished from public ones in requirements, with how "not reachable from outside" is to be verified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023, contracts/gateway-routes.md]

## Order, Stock & Payment Domain Rules

- [x] CHK021 Do the order lifecycle statements agree between US5, FR-015, data-model §3.4 and order.yaml, including the transient `placed`, `payment pending`, `payment failed` and the expiry-to-cancelled path? [Conflict, Spec §US5, §FR-015, plan.md Design Decisions]
- [x] CHK022 Is the stock reservation model stated as a requirement (synchronous reserve at checkout, commit on approval, release on failure/cancel/expiry) rather than only as a Phase 1 decision? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, plan.md Design Decisions]
- [x] CHK023 Are the idempotency semantics fully specified: key format, scope (per account), retention 24 h, same-key-different-body outcome, concurrent duplicates serialising? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, research §10, order.yaml]
- [x] CHK024 Are cancellation rules complete for every actor: shopper only before `preparing`, operator until `shipped`, system on expiry, and the refund expectation for each? [Coverage, Spec §FR-016–017, data-model §3.4]
- [x] CHK025 Is "price frozen at confirmation" reconciled with "cart shows current price and flags changes" so there is no ambiguity about which price an order uses when the cart was not refreshed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010–011, US2 scenario 4]
- [x] CHK026 Is the simulated provider's rule document a stated requirement (deterministic, operator-readable, fixed in contract) with the pending/unreachable behaviour and 30-minute expiry defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, research §11]
- [x] CHK027 Are refund requirements defined (full only, recorded against the attempt, always succeeds in simulation, event emitted) and consistent between data-model §3.5, payment.yaml and events.yaml? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK028 Are the cart-merge rules unambiguous for all cases: same product in both carts, stock cap, withdrawn product in the anonymous cart, two anonymous carts on two devices? [Edge Case, Spec §US2 scenario 3, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK029 Are the stock-adjustment requirements for operators (reason mandatory, negative adjustments below reserved stock, audit fields) complete and do they define what happens to open reservations? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, data-model §3.2]
- [x] CHK030 Can "exactly one order succeeds" under concurrent checkout be objectively verified from the requirements as written (test conditions, instance count, expected refusal)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Platform & Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK031 Are the performance targets stated with measurement conditions (catalogue size, concurrency, warm/cold cache, p95 definition, environment) so SC-002 and SC-003 can be reproduced? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002–003]
- [x] CHK032 Are observability requirements specific about which fields every log entry must carry and which metrics each service must expose, beyond "request, error and latency"? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025–026, research §3]
- [x] CHK033 Is "traffic continues when an instance is stopped" quantified (zero client-visible errors after in-flight requests, convergence time bounded by the 5 s DNS TTL) and consistent between SC-008 and research §2? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008, research §2]
- [x] CHK034 Are the one-command start-up requirements complete: profiles, seed data contents, health-check definition, time budget, resource assumptions (8 GB RAM)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-027, quickstart.md]
- [x] CHK035 Is "independent build and publish per service" defined precisely (path filters, what counts as a shared change that rebuilds all, image tagging) so SC-009 is verifiable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028, research §4]
- [x] CHK036 Are the private-registry consequences (images only reachable on the runner host, local Compose builds from source) stated as accepted constraints with the trigger for revisiting them? [Assumption, research §5, plan.md Complexity Tracking]
- [x] CHK037 Are degradation and recovery requirements defined for broker or database unavailability (outbox backlog, consumer lag, read-only behaviour), beyond the payment-provider-unreachable case? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases, Constitution VI]
- [x] CHK038 Are data-retention requirements (idempotency 24 h, processed events 7 days, anonymous carts 30 days, notifications 90 days) present in the spec or explicitly delegated to the data model with those values? [Completeness, data-model §5]

## Dependencies, Assumptions & Open Items

- [x] CHK039 Are the open follow-ups in research §14 (Arcmutate licence path, runner image name, Kotlin version pinning) recorded as explicit assumptions or tasks with an owner, rather than left as notes? [Assumption, research §14]
- [x] CHK040 Is the proposed constitution amendment (Spring Boot "3.x" wording) and the Flyway blocking exception each recorded where `/speckit-tasks` and PR reviewers will see them? [Traceability, plan.md Complexity Tracking, research §14]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items whose answer is "no" are candidates for `/speckit-clarify` (spec wording) or direct edits to plan.md, data-model.md or contracts/ before `/speckit-tasks`
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
